sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2024 Ferrari Roma Spider, finished in red with a black soft top and a black interior. The attached Carfax history report lists no accidents in this Roma's past. A window sticker is provided in the photo gallery, and a partial list of notable equipment reported by the selling dealer includes carbon ceramic brakes, a power-folding soft top, and a 16-inch digital instrument cluster. The selling dealer reports no notable modifications. Ferrari introduced the Roma in 2020 with a front mid-mounted twin-turbo V8, rear-wheel drive, fantastic technology, and beautiful styling. As a luxurious 2+2 with legitimate supercar performance chops, the Roma is arguably one of the most desirable exotic GT cars of the past decade. Power comes from a 3.9-liter twin-turbocharged V8, rated at 612 horsepower and 561 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via an 8-speed automatic transmission.
